_: Botania, from ATM6's census (W4 R6, judged 2026-11-11). Livingrock is the natural rock of Alfheim's ground, as the census saw it there, and the rules leave it out for having no stone word. Named alone, the one block that census judged, because a word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it. Its bricks, slabs, stairs and walls were not judged and are left to the rules.

The metamorphic forest stone, natural rock of the forest biomes as the other metamorphic stones are, which the rules leave out where they read the others' stone word, is named as 1.20.1's file has it, so the editions match (W4 R14, 2026-11-13); its cobblestone, bricks, slabs and stairs are left to the rules.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.16.5 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
